correctness.rationale: The positive ratio r=y/x yields exact monotone projective dynamics with D(r). Rational quadrature produces the three explicit K*Phi(r) profiles; in the parameter wedge both x and y tend to zero at r=0 and infinity, are bounded, and polynomial uniqueness proves complete homoclinic trajectories. Reciprocal species derivatives and ratio integration establish dominant 1/t tails, minority powers and leading equality-boundary logarithms. Outside the wedge, explicit invariant cones with quadratic blow-up inequalities disprove all-positive completeness. Exact checker confirms critical algebra but not global dynamics.

value.rationale: The contemporaneous chemical-network classification presents a single homoclinic example. The new theorem gives a natural all-rate, all-initial-state iff classification, quantifies two different critical slowing regimes with universal logarithmic coefficients, and proves sharpness by open blow-up sets. This global kinetic threshold is motivated by the actual reaction network and cannot be replaced by an arbitrary single-rate computation.
